answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because bridge only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, comet is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any canyon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
